_about: GLANCE spoken sign-offs, in ALIS's voice (calm and precise, JARVIS / Star Trek computer, feminine tone, dry wit used lightly). Each slot is a pool of lines; GLANCE picks one per slot per ISO week, so the line changes every Monday and stays the same all week. Add, remove or reword lines freely - keep them as plain spoken sentences (no symbols), and avoid lines that claim everything is fine, since the brief may have just mentioned a warning.
